textarea.label: Your words
textarea.tip: Speak first using Record above. Words land here automatically. Or type directly. Or paste from Wispr Flow. Any language works here.
textarea.placeholder: Record your voice or type anything: a birthday wish, memory, recipe, love letter, gratitude, advice...

nameRow.label: From
nameRow.placeholder: e.g. Mom, Durga, Taylor, Sensei, Abuela, Pi Lisa, Ella...

tone.label: Tone
tone.tip: Original preserves your exact words, unlimited, no daily cap. Other tones rewrite via AI: Warm is gentle, Bold is direct, Poetic flows with rhythm, Playful is light, Reflective is slow, Honest is raw. Changes letter-spacing and slant only, not size or weight.

color.label: Card color
color.tip: Sets the card background. The live preview updates instantly.

shape.label: Shape
shape.tip: Sharp edges work best for WhatsApp. Rounded corners suit galleries and web.

fontSize.label: Font size
fontSize.tip: Make short card text larger so it fills the card nicely. Only available while your card text is short.
fontSize.info: Available only when your card text is under 85 characters
fontSize.infoOn: Your card text is short: tap + or − to adjust the size
